meta.contrast: Legacy 2%: all 164 conflict rows are single-run precedence_days_since episodes -- one of five trained clauses, and never a two-run episode (take_stratified concatenated the ten clause x run-count groups and build_all_cells took drawn[0:164]). Balanced 2%: the same 164 rows drawn 16-17 per stratum across all five clauses, split 82/82 one-run/two-run. Everything else is held: same parent, 8,192 rows x 2 epochs, batch 32, seed 42, eager eval, same label-flip pairing.
meta.legacy_side: scored/<profile>/<arm>/eval.json, endpoints mixed_charter-step* / mixed_coin-step* — the campaign's own narrow-conflict cells, read in place rather than copied
